thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH — auth-proxy spike: elevated 401s + suspicious GETs to /v1/logs from 52.14.200.0/24, possible log scraping. Alert: auth.rate.peak + s3-access-errors. https://ops.monitor/alert/1760202020 :rotating_light:

sre-jamie: Oncall Jamie here, taking. Paging sec + infra. Any immediate customer impact? I'll start a quick triage and update.

eng-alex: quick find: burst of 401s and token reuse. example log:
```
2025-07-10T21:12:01Z auth-proxy GET /v1/logs 401 src=52.14.200.12 token=redacted ua="curl/7.68"
```

sec-erin: pattern looks like automated scraping + token replay. Can someone run token-lookup for that token prefix and list recent sessions? @ops-mike pls escalate IDP revoke if confirmed.

ops-mike: acknowledged. Kicking off emergency key rotation for proxy service-account. Running rotation job against prod proxies (no restarts). ETA ~8m. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/key-rotate

eng-alex: command I used to enumerate:
```
rg "src=52.14.200" /var/log/proxy/*.log | sed -n '1,40p'
```
found ~24 matching sessions across tenant-A and tenant-B.

cust-success-nina: FYI — two customers (acme, beta-inc) submitted auth error tickets ~15m ago. Not yet escalated externally.

sre-jamie: Immediate mitigations: block CIDR 52.14.200.0/24 at edge, tighten rate limit on /v1/logs to 10r/s, enable WAF rule for suspicious UA. @infra-bot please apply.

infra-bot: edge rule applied: deny 52.14.200.0/24. rate-limit updated for POST/GET /v1/logs -> 10r/s. WAF rule #3200 enabled.

ops-mike: key rotation finished for service-account proxy-svc-1. Rotation ID: rot-1760202020-01. Keys rolled and deployed to proxies; tokens issued after rotation. No proxy restarts.

sec-erin: initiated token invalidation for sessions created by that SA in last 24h; IDP session revoke in progress. Also pulling S3 access logs for the last 48h to search for unauthorized GETs.

legal-kate: preserve all logs and snapshots; do NOT purge. We're opening a security incident record. I want a copy of the evidence bucket when ready.

eng-alex: found 3 requests including stack traces in query params — saving artifacts to secure-evidence bucket (s3://redwood-sec-evidence/1760202020/).

cust-success-nina: drafting customer comms: "We're investigating authentication anomalies affecting a small set of requests; no confirmed data exfiltration at this time." Will hold send until sec confirms.

incident-bot: Edge block suppressed alert. Severity downgraded to P2 pending forensics. Incident timeline created: #inc-1760202020.

sre-jamie: handing off active investigation to sec-eng Erin for deeper forensics. I'll stay on-call for ops coordination. @sec-erin please take lead and update incident doc.

sec-erin: taking lead. Spinning up forensic VM, collecting proxy logs + S3 access/audit logs, and starting timeline analysis. ETA initial forensic triage 30m.

legal-kate: please capture list of affected tenants and scope of any exposed fields. I'll review regulatory obligations and advise on notification if needed.

ops-mike: note appended: key-rotate timestamp 2025-07-10T21:18:30Z, rot-1760202020-01.

sre-jamie: next steps: sec to validate evidence, ops to confirm no remaining active IPs, infra to keep block in place for 24h, cs to prep customer notices. We'll reconvene 30m or earlier if new findings.

sec-erin: will update incident doc with list of suspicious IPs, token IDs, and evidence artifacts. Opening a Zoom if needed.

cust-success-nina: I'll queue the two customers for an update after the 30m triage.

sre-jamie: thanks all. Keep channel clear for live updates. Closing initial paging loop — handing to sec for long-form investigation.
